detail.longDescription: Received: We’re writing to let you know that as part of our work to unify our agentic coding efforts, Jules will wind down on December 31, 2026. You have until November 11, 2026 to continue finishing up sessions. After November 11, 2026, we will be turning Jules to read-only until the end of the year. When we launched Jules, it was an experiment to learn how asynchronous coding agents could help you tackle your backlog and ship faster. What you built with it taught us where agentic development is headed, and those learnings are shaping products across Google, including our agent-first platform, Google Antigravity.
